english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a brief flash or gleam of light.
For a light that blinks or flashes on and off, 閃 is the all-purpose choice.

examples.english: The ring can glint briefly in the sunlight.
examples.traditional: 戒指喺陽光下閃咗一下。
examples.jyutping: gaai3 zi2 hai2 joeng4 gwong1 haa6 sim2 zo2 jat1 haa5

examples.english: I see the lamp flash on and off, making my eyes go blurry.
examples.traditional: 盞燈閃吓閃吓，搞到我眼都花。
examples.jyutping: zaan2 dang1 sim2 haa5 sim2 haa5 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 ngaan5 dou1 faa1

english.note: Use this colloquial verb when someone is leaving abruptly or says they have to dash.

examples.english: I have something to do, so I have to dash now.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jau5 si6 jiu3 sim2 laa3
